- **Date:** 2026-08-04  
  **Source:** [OpenAI — Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6](https://openai.com/index/advancing-the-price-performance-frontier-with-gpt-5-6/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI says it is lowering prices for GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra and introducing Fast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol in the API. The update also indicates GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna remain available across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the OpenAI API.
